title: [猫の仓库] 汉化本整理计划（上半）[3037本]
description:
由于我的水管和硬盘都比较紧张，因此不会长期做种，希望各位多多帮忙保种一下吧。

***

事情是这样的，我收集的一些汉化本子，会被我丢到一个名为“汉化本”文件夹中，经过了七年多的成长，它已经是一个包含了一万多个文件的成熟文件夹了。

所以，一些整理工作就势在必行了。

本次上传的合集包含了115位作者，计划是整理大概200多位作者，因此是上半。

至于下半，大概明年再见吧……

***

以下关于此合集的一些说明：

这是一个仅包含了汉化本的合集，全部的更新时间大致截止于2023年6月。

这些本子的文件来源包括但不限于NH、EH、WN等本子集散地，以及北+、亭子等论坛。因此存在一些图片并非原图画质的问题，并且可能会存在文件重复、文件损坏。我在整理过程中仅进行了大致的检查，因此合集中可能依旧存在上述问题。因为文件数目庞大，且无法使用脚本工具便捷操作，所以校对是一项浩如烟海的工作，只能寄希望于此合集后续的更新中逐步解决。

整理后的文件是根据作者进行分类的，并且提供了预览图。整理时我尽可能的标准化了文件名格式，部分同人本缺失了展会信息，由于考据这些信息意义并不大，因此不做补充。对于一些汉化组撞坑的本，仅保留了画质更好的版本。

对于一些更新提请、以及关于此合集的文件损坏、文件名错误等通知，可以在TG群找到我，或者在网站留言。

PS：为了补充文件我连EH攒了好几年的点数都耗光了……（话说这玩意能转账吗有没有大佬赞助一点。

description:

Also, this version was updated to not require a separate installer: the game will install itself upon the first launch of KimiIta.exe and will start as normal on subsequent launches. Due to how it works, your antivirus may trigger a false positive. It also includes the Universal rUGP Win10 crash fix (https://vndb.org/r94522).

Difference from the version in https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3211792 : includes all updates and DLC, portable. Yes, the 20th Box version only includes the base game.

title: [coolsister] Erina and Daemon Machina City Demo v0.90
description:
![Demo](https://i.imgur.com/coBn7j2.png)
__Links__: N/A
__Version__: 0.90
__Patch Notes__: N/A

__About__:
A small translation project I've been working on since the release of the demo by coolsister on their Ci-en page a couple of weeks ago. The translation covers everything available in the demo including the limited H-scenes you can access. Most of the translation has been edited a few times, but there's plenty of spots where it might be rough or weird (including formatting issues), but that's something that can be fixed along the way. No machine-tools were used in the making of this translation.

If you're interested in getting the latest updates on any translation changes, you can check the GitHub repository I set up (which might get changed depending on stuff) here: https://github.com/Tanjoubi/Erina-and-Daemon-Machina-City. If you can report any issues there, that would help as well. Plan is to do the full game, but may take a lot of time depending on how much volume the game ends up being on release.

Support coolsister by buying the game if you like what you see in the demo. Note that this demo is only about 1-3 hours long.
